context.hint: Review a tool preflight guard that classifies version-control commands before execution.
context.surface: A local command hook receives a shell command and returns a policy decision before any version-control operation is launched.
assumptions: The command guard applies a documented policy to allowed and denied operations.
A fixture can check decisions without executing the underlying commands.

review.invariant: The hook consistently denies operations covered by its policy and preserves permitted commands and inspection modes.
review.verification: Assert decisions against a fixture matrix of denied and permitted operations at the hook boundary, with command execution disabled. Use a structured command interface where available.

source_observation.summary: The revised hook passed 27 policy decisions and controls under a compatibility fixture. Full shell interpretation and the production hook integration were outside the verified scope.
